webhook_owned_elsewhere.title: Diagral webhook used by another installation: {entry_title}

confirm.title: Take over the Diagral webhook
confirm.description:
The Diagral cloud sends the events of **{entry_title}** to another installation (**{other_host}**), so Home Assistant does not receive them. Intrusion alerts only arrive this way: the alarm panel cannot show *triggered* while this lasts. Polling still updates the arming state every 5 minutes.

The integration no longer overwrites a subscription it did not create. If **{other_host}** is not in use any more, or you want this installation to receive the events, confirm below: the subscription will point here, and **{other_host}** will stop receiving events.

You can also do this at any time with the `diagral.register_webhook` action.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The Diagral integration is not loaded. Reload it, then try again.
abort.take_over_failed: The Diagral cloud refused the change. Check the logs, then try again.

webhook_registration_failed.title: Diagral webhook could not be registered: {entry_title}

confirm.title: Retry the Diagral webhook registration
confirm.description:
Home Assistant could not register its webhook with the Diagral cloud for **{entry_title}**, so it does not receive Diagral events. Intrusion alerts only arrive this way: the alarm panel cannot show *triggered* while this lasts. Polling still updates the arming state every 5 minutes.

This usually comes from a temporary outage of the Diagral cloud or of Home Assistant Cloud. Confirm below to try again; reloading the integration does the same.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The Diagral integration is not loaded. Reload it, then try again.
abort.retry_failed: The registration failed again. Check the logs, then try again later.

webhook_no_url.title: No address for the Diagral webhook: {entry_title}
webhook_no_url.description:
Home Assistant cannot receive Diagral events for **{entry_title}**: the Diagral cloud needs an HTTPS address reachable from the internet, and none is available. Intrusion alerts only arrive this way: the alarm panel cannot show *triggered* while this lasts. Polling still updates the arming state every 5 minutes.

To fix it, set an external URL starting with `https://` in **Settings > System > Network**, or connect Home Assistant Cloud with an active subscription. Then reload the Diagral integration.
